notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[p]A new update is here! 🎉
We’ve been working on polishing the experience and fixing some issues reported by the community.[/p][h3]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]✅ Adjusted Mix’s dialogue resolution at the end of the last level in each world.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fixed a bug where bullets stopped working after restarting a level.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Resolved an issue that caused progress loss when replaying a previous level.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Properly aligned the [b]“Back To Main Menu”[/b] text on the world selection screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing [b]Mix It[/b] and sharing your feedback with us. [/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Special News[/h3][p]We had the amazing opportunity to showcase [b]Mix It[/b] at [b]Gamescom Cologne[/b] this year!
And even better — we’ve released a brand-new trailer! 🚀 Don’t miss it![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hBt3xDU_PdM;full"][/previewyoutube]
